ffmpeg.wasm — source and build information

The shipped wrapper (@ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.12.15) and single-thread core
(@ffmpeg/core 0.12.10) are unmodified npm release files. Upstream's v12.15
release explicitly includes these two package versions.

Wrapper license: MIT; see WRAPPER-LICENSE.txt.
Core license: GPL-2.0-or-later; see CORE-GPL-2.0.txt.
Bundled dependency license texts are in licenses/. Complete source trees
and build information are linked below.
No warranty is provided by the upstream authors.

Corresponding wrapper, FFmpeg modifications, build scripts and Dockerfile:
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v12.15
Download source: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/archive/refs/tags/v12.15.tar.gz
Build instructions: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/blob/v12.15/CONTRIBUTING.md
Exact build recipe: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/blob/v12.15/Dockerfile

Source dependencies selected by that build recipe:
FFmpeg n5.1.4: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n5.1.4
x264: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/x264/tree/4-cores
x265: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/x265/tree/3.4
libvpx: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/libvpx/tree/v1.13.1
lame: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/lame/tree/master
Ogg: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/Ogg/tree/v1.3.4
theora: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/theora/tree/v1.1.1
opus: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/opus/tree/v1.3.1
vorbis: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/vorbis/tree/v1.3.3
zlib: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/zlib/tree/v1.2.11
libwebp: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/libwebp/tree/v1.3.2
freetype: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/freetype2/tree/VER-2-10-4
fribidi: https://github.com/fribidi/fribidi/tree/v1.0.9
harfbuzz: https://github.com/harfbuzz/harfbuzz/tree/5.2.0
libass: https://github.com/libass/libass/tree/0.15.0
zimg: https://github.com/sekrit-twc/zimg/tree/release-3.0.5
Emscripten SDK 3.1.40: https://github.com/emscripten-core/emsdk/tree/3.1.40

The engine can be replaced by a compatible modified build at
core/ffmpeg-core.js and core/ffmpeg-core.wasm. The wrapper can be replaced
in wrapper/. See upstream's build recipe for compiling the single-thread
ES module distribution with Emscripten 3.1.40.
